title: Release ecosystem fit checklist and velocity log
content:
Purpose:
A compact operational checklist + velocity log to evaluate whether a product release meets cross-functional ecosystem fit for controlled rollouts. Intended for product-ops to drive decisioning from internal beta -> staged production. Keep this doc lightweight: owners, measurable gates, telemetry hooks, and fast rollback criteria.

Scope and audience:
- Scope: NEW feature release or model-serving change that will affect customer-visible latency, cost-per-token, or correctness signals.
- Audience: product-ops (primary), eng-serving-runtime, infra, SRE, console, solutions-eng, GTM on-call.

Quick summary of acceptance hypothesis:
- Hypothesis: Release X reduces unit inference cost by >=10% without degrading 95th-percentile latency beyond +40ms and without increasing customer error rate (NLP degradation) by >0.5% relative to baseline on our eval set.
- Success window: first 72 hours of staged traffic at 10% of target cohort. If any metric breaks gating thresholds, rollback.

KPIs and operational thresholds (measurable gates):
- Stability & latency:
  - 95th-percentile latency (p95): baseline 180ms -> gate p95 <= 220ms (+40ms tolerated).
  - Error rate (5xxs, timeouts): baseline 0.12% -> gate <=0.5%.
- Quality:
  - Eval prompt regression: top-line quality delta <= 0.5% on the canonical prompt set (eval-run id linked).
  - Support signal delta: elevated support tickets referencing model hallucinations or missing functionality <= +10 tickets/day above baseline for cohort.
- Cost & throughput:
  - Cost-per-token: expected delta <= -10% (win) or within +/-2% (neutral).
  - Throughput headroom: ability to sustain 2x nominal RPS in staging without queue depth > 4s.
- Business signals:
  - Activation conversion rate: no more than 5% relative drop in the first 48h.
  - Latent revenue impact: no immediate >1% drop in paid feature usage.

Velocity log (daily snapshot entries — fill during rollout):
- Day 0 (canary start) owner: Maya T.
  - Traffic: 1% production traffic -> cohort A (internal + invited beta).
  - Observed p95: 176ms; error rate: 0.10%; cost-per-token: -11% vs baseline; eval-delta: +0.02%
  - Notes: healthy. Proceed to staged 10% after 6 hours of stable telemetry.
- Day 1 (staged 10%) owner: Luca M.
  - Traffic: 10% -> external cohort 1.
  - Observed p95: 205ms (within gate); error rate: 0.18%; support-ticket delta: +2/day; cost-per-token -9% (slightly less than projected)
  - Action items: infra to increase autoscale headroom to prep for 2x surge test; run targeted eval with longer-context prompts.
- Day 2 (expand / monitor) owner: Priya S.
  - Traffic: 25% gradual ramp target; observed p95: 230ms (breach); error rate: 0.35%
  - Decision: pause rollout and investigate model-quantization fallback path. Initiate rollback to last stable variant for affected routes if p95 > 220ms after mitigation window.

Checklist (pre-rollout & live guardrails) — owners required for each row:
- Preconditions / preflight (complete before any canary traffic):
  - [ ] Canary runbook written and accessible (owner: Daniel K) — link to runbook in linked_artifacts.
  - [ ] Targeted eval set executed and baseline comparisons attached (owner: Priya S).
  - [ ] Cost-model update and unit-economics forecast in Console (owner: Finance contact)
  - [ ] Capacity test: 2x RPS soak in staging for 30m with no queue depth > 4s (owner: infra).
  - [ ] Security review for private deployments (if applicable) (owner: security).
  - [ ] SLO bump plan and alert owners assigned (owner: SRE lead).

- Live rollout controls:
  - [ ] Traffic ramp schedule published with timestamps and owners for each step (owner: product-ops).
  - [ ] Automated kill-switch configured (route-level fallback to previous model variant) and tested (owner: serving-runtime).
  - [ ] Observability dashboards: latency, error-rate, cost per token, quality regression score, support ticket feed (owner: observability).
  - [ ] Chat/Slack Ops channel pre-created with escalation list and runbook pinned (owner: product-ops).
  - [ ] Experiment config: annotation of cohorts, model_variant ids, feature-gate flags (owner: console-and-tooling).

Rollback and mitigation matrix (fast decisions):
- If p95 breach > +40ms for > 20m: run mitigation 1 (increase instance concurrency / fall back to higher-precision kernel) — if not resolved within 30m -> immediate rollback to previous variant for affected routes.
- If error-rate > 0.5% sustained for > 15m: immediate rollback and page SRE.
- If eval-delta > 0.5% on canonical prompt set or significant customer-reported quality issues (>10 corroborated reports in 12h): pause rollout and begin quality hotfix path.
- If cost delta worse than +5% and revenue signals drop >1%: pause rollout and run financial impact analysis before proceeding.

Risk register (short):
- Model quantization may create latency regressions for long-context prompts — mitigation: selective route tagging to exclude long-context routes until kernel fix. Owner: serving-runtime
- Autoscaling lag under sudden burst (external event) — mitigation: pre-warm extra capacity and enable burst policy. Owner: infra
- Monitoring blind spots for reranked / post-processed routes — mitigation: ensure end-to-end traces are enabled and sampling rates increased. Owner: observability

Signoff matrix (final gating for full 100% rollout):
- Required signoffs: Product-ops lead (Maya T), Eng-serving-runtime (Daniel K), SRE (Sara N), Observability (Luca M), Finance (Priya S).
- Criteria: All preflight checklist items completed, no open critical tickets in last 24h, KPIs within gates for 72h at 25% traffic, runbook and rollback tested.

Notes to reviewers / TODOs:
- Attach the canonical eval-run id and the per-route telemetry CSVs to this doc after each day snapshot.
- Add a short “what changed” blurb for front-line support and a one-line release note for customers if roll is unremarkable.
- Confirm if Dedicated customers need an opt-in or separate rollout path (solutions-eng to confirm).

Appendix: quick links and short commands
- Canary kill-switch: POST https://console.redwood.ai/internal/rollouts/kill?variant=stable (test in dry-run)
- Staging RPS soak job: infra job id ISK-2025-staging-soak
- Eval harness: https://ci.redwood.ai/job/eval-harness/run/734

End of doc.
